title: Michael–Simon Sobolev inequality (Simon 5.7–5.9, corrected Lemma 5.8, n ≥ 2)
statement: Assume ApproxTangentAE and (GF). Then SobolevInequality holds: for n ≥ 2 there is c = c(n) > 0 (one may take c = 5^{n+1}ω_n^{−1/n}), independent of ℓ, such that if V has generalized mean curvature H (merely L¹_loc) in an open U, θ ≥ 1 μ_V-a.e. in U, and h ∈ C¹(U) is nonnegative with compact support in U, then (∫ h^{n/(n−1)} dμ_V)^{(n−1)/n} ≤ c∫(|∇^M h| + h|H|) dμ_V.
lean_statement: ApproxTangentAE → (∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ), 0 < n → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, Module.finrank ℝ (V.tangentSpace x) = n) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ (V.tangentSpace x).starProjection) V.weight) → SobolevInequality
